definition: the work of looking after someone
description: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.

en.question: What is the older woman doing?

de.answer: Sie kümmert sich um die junge Frau.
de.question: Was macht die ältere Frau?

es.answer: Está cuidando a la mujer joven.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer mayor?

fr.answer: Elle prend soin de la jeune femme.
fr.question: Que fait la femme plus âgée ?
